VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the velocity rule and that "all 31 tests pass locally," there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Local test passage is not equivalent to verified acceptance criteria satisfaction, especially for a fraud detection system where correctness is critical. Independent verification through CI/CD pipelines, signed test reports, or code review would be required to establish confidence in this fix.
